summary.name: Droply
summary.one_liner: Droply is a native macOS app that removes image backgrounds locally using AI segmentation, sold as a one-time purchase instead of a subscription.
use_cases: Removing backgrounds from e-commerce product photos
Batch removing backgrounds from many images at once
Extracting elements for design compositions and mockups
Removing green screen backgrounds from images
Preparing images with transparent backgrounds for social media
summary.what_it_does: Droply is a native macOS app for removing image backgrounds. You drag and drop an image and it automatically detects the main subject, using an AI segmentation model. It claims to preserve fine details such as hair and transparent edges. Batch processing handles multiple images at once, and processed images can be dragged into Finder, browsers, or other apps that accept file drops. Output is exported as PNG or JPEG with transparent backgrounds, and the page says it imports most photo formats. All processing is stated to happen locally on the Mac, with no internet connection required.
notable: Runs fully offline with local processing; no images leave the device
One-time payment with unlimited processing and future updates included
Batch processing of multiple images and drag-out to other apps
Listed in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac under Design Tools
caveats: Requires a one-time payment (page shows a limited-time price of $9)
macOS only; optimized for Apple Silicon
Listed price and terms may change; the 'limited time offer' is stated on the page
